Two doses differing 2.1-fold are statistically indistinguishable in vector genomes and mRNA across four brain regions — seven of eight comparisons ns, the exception being hippocampal DNA — while producing opposite survival outcomes. Cerebellum stays below wild type at both doses; the hippocampal KO lane reads 1.1 where the other three blots read 0.02, 0.03 and 0.08.

The liver result is clean: treated lanes sit in the same 0.03-0.1 range as untreated Wwox-null lanes, i.e. at background for an animal with no WWOX. Cerebellum remains below wild type at P300, confirming from a second timepoint what Figure 5L showed at P30.

entries.proposition: Figure 1 as drawn (glucose at P14, n = 5 to 6): KO+RI about 58 mg/dL against WT about 137; EF1-alpha vector about 102 (partial; asterisks against both) with all treated mice dead by about P20, as in KO; CMV vector about 131 (ns against WT) with survival falling to 40 percent of 5 animals by about day 32 and the plot ending at day 35 with those 40 percent still shown (possibly censored); MBP vector about 50, no change; synapsin vector about 131 (ns against WT) with full survival over the 50-day window. Glucose is therefore corrected by CMV, and partly by EF1-alpha, without WT-like survival (3 of 5 CMV animals dead by day 32; all EF1-alpha animals dead by about day 20), so glycaemic correction at P14 does not predict lethality.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 3B READ AT NATIVE RESOLUTION AND MEASURED AGAINST ITS PRINTED AXES - the manifest had no Figure 3B entry at all until now, while CLAIM 011's dose flag rested on a panel reading of it. Survival is a STEP on this panel and not a gradient: the low-dose arm reaches zero at ~day 79 while the high-dose arm holds 100 percent to ~day 50 and then plateaus at or marginally above the wild-type control's own survival, which is what the caption's p = 0.78 means. Two numbers asserted in the flag's prose are corrected by measurement (the untreated knockout's zero marker is centred at ~day 17, not ~day 15 or ~day 20; the plateau is 76-77 percent, not ~80), and neither of them sat behind any locator. CORRECTED 2026-10-21 after a blind audit returned UNDERSHOOT: the panel says MORE for the high dose than this entry first recorded, and the cause is a reading lesson, not a measurement error - a censoring tick sitting on the 100 percent line was read as the last point before a drop, and the 23 days in which the red curve is hidden under the navy wild-type line at the same height were read as its absence.

entries.proposition: THE DOSE DOES NOT GRADE BODY WEIGHT, WHICH NO RECORD IN THIS REPOSITORY HAD STATED. At P30 the two treated arms are superimposed and no significance marker of any kind is printed on either panel. 🔴 The comparison is SURVIVOR-CONDITIONED ON THE LOW-DOSE SIDE AND NOT ON THE HIGH-DOSE SIDE, which is a limit on the equality rather than a qualification of it: Figure 3B, the same figure, puts the LD arm at ~79 percent alive at P30 and ~30-40 percent alive at day 60, against 100 percent for HD at both ages. CORRECTED 2026-10-21 after a blind audit returned OVERSHOOT: this entry previously explained panel D's low-dose series ending at day 60 by saying the arm was extinct. It was not - extinction is ~day 79. A SERIES ENDING IS NOT A COHORT ENDING; the truncation is the panel's own and the source states no cause for it.

Figure 3D to P180: WT+RI ~26.9 g and KO+HD ~26.0 g at day 180 with overlapping error bars, KO+LD series TRUNCATED at day 60 at ~21 g with no cause stated on the panel or in its caption, KO+RI last point ~day 15 at ~5 g; no significance marker printed on panel D either. contradicts_locator.what_changed: OVERSHOOT repaired at source. The quote reproduced exactly - every value, both terminations and the absence of any asterisk or ns on panels C and D - so 'weight is not dose-graded' stands. What failed was the explanation attached to it: 'the long-term panel's low-dose curve ends because the arm is extinct' is not what Figure 3 shows, since 3B puts LD at ~30-40 percent alive at day 60 and extinct only at ~day 79. The cell now records the series TRUNCATION with its cause unstated, and adds the limit the first version missed - the weight equality is survivor-conditioned on the LD side (~79 percent alive at P30) and not on the HD side (100 percent), so it could mask a dose effect in either direction.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 7E CONTAINS NO LOW-DOSE ARM, SO THE ECoG DOMAIN CANNOT SUPPORT A DOSE-DEPENDENT CLAIM AT ALL - read from a 400 dpi PAGE render because this figure's quantitative panels are vector in the PDF. The rescue itself is real and is the study's single cleanest CNS-electrophysiological endpoint: the treated arm is statistically indistinguishable from wild type. Panel 7C's printed 0.2000 against the running text's 'significant elevation' is CONFIRMED at 400 dpi, not contradicted, and at this resolution 7C resolves two distinct WT markers and three distinct KO markers against a caption stating n = 5 per group - markers may overlap at identical values and the panel cannot discriminate, so this is recorded as a limit of the panel and not as evidence against the caption.

entries.proposition: THE OLIGODENDROCYTE ARM PRODUCED NO BENEFIT AND NO DETECTABLE PROTEIN, AND THE SECOND FACT IS WHAT KEEPS THE FIRST FROM BEING A NEGATIVE RESULT ABOUT OLIGODENDROCYTES - read at 300 dpi. The MBP-promoter survival curve is indistinguishable from the untreated knockout; at P14 the treated group is significantly BELOW wild type (the long **** bracket runs WT+RI to MBP+W) and NOT different from the untreated knockout (ns), which is the stronger form of 'no benefit'; and panel M shows the MBP column essentially blank. The cassette also differs from the dose study: the promoter-comparison vectors all carry WPRE at 4e10 vg, which is not the WPRE-free 4e10 of Figure 2. CORRECTED 2026-10-21 after a blind audit returned OVERSHOOT on two clauses of panel content and one dose clause.

contradicts_locator.what_changed: OVERSHOOT repaired at source, three clauses, none of them the load-bearing negative. (i) Panel H: the MBP+W series does not end at ~day 17 - it runs to ~day 21 at ~5.25 g, and it is the KO+RI series that ends, at ~day 19 at ~4.2 g; the two were transposed. (ii) Panel I: the **** bracket is not WT versus KO+RI - it spans the full panel from WT+RI to the MBP-treated bar, as the long brackets in F and L do, and the Figure 1 caption's own sentence that no significant difference was found for the MBP group compared with KO+RI is the ns bracket. This makes the no-benefit statement STRONGER, not weaker. (iii) 'the 4e10 of Figures 2 and 3' named a dose Figure 3 does not contain - Figure 3 runs 1.23e11 and 2.63e11 only - so the comparison is now made against Figure 2 alone. The load-bearing ns between KO+RI and MBP+W, the blank MBP column in panel M and the survival curve in G all reproduced and are unchanged.

entries.proposition: The Figure 3B caption's own statistics, quoted so that the panel entry above has a text sentence to qualify rather than qualifying claim prose. Three facts the caption fixes: the high dose is NOT distinguishable from wild type (p = 0.78), the high dose IS distinguishable from the low dose, and the LOW DOSE IS ALSO SIGNIFICANTLY BETTER THAN THE UNTREATED KNOCKOUT - which is why 'the low dose does nothing' is refused by this reading.
entries.snippet: HD produced survival comparable to WT animals (p = 0.78), and significantly extended survival relative to the LD group (p < 0.0001) and the KO + RI controls (p < 0.0001). LD also significantly improved survival compared with the KO + RI controls (p < 0.0001).
